description: Use for any question about open trips or day outs to join: by city slug, month (YYYY-MM), kind (trip or dayout), budget tier or mood. Each hook carries its public TripHook page (url) and, for a day out, the What's on page (event_page). The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · Find a crew". Public fields only, never a person. For any where should I go, where is warm or budget question, use search_destinations instead.

budget.description: Budget tier the host set: "budget", "mid" or "comfort".

city.description: City slug, lower case with hyphens, e.g. "lisbon" or "new-york". list_cities returns the slugs.

kind.description: "trip" for a group trip of several days, "dayout" for a single day out, often to an event.

limit.description: How many hooks to return, 1 to 200. Default 20.

mood.description: The trip's mood, one of the listed values, e.g. "cultural-immersion".

name: search_public_hooks
title: Search public TripHook hooks
